title: Hafnium Ore
pages: Hafnium Ore and Deepslate Hafnium Ore generate deep in the Overworld between Y -64 and 32 (veins of size 6, at most one vein per chunk column). An iron pickaxe or better is required. Silk Touch keeps the block; ordinary mining drops Raw Hafnium and Fortune can increase the yield. Required industrial use: phase stabilizer. Its craft consumes this ingot; compatible forge:ingots/hafnium inputs are accepted.

Smelt or blast Raw Hafnium into Hafnium Ingots. The Crusher processes one Raw Hafnium into two Hafnium Grit in 200 ticks at 6 energy per tick; each grit smelts or blasts into an ingot. Feed the Crusher through an input face and extract its output with a hopper or item capability, then automate a furnace or blast furnace.

Hafnium uses forge:ores/hafnium, forge:raw_materials/hafnium and forge:ingots/hafnium tags. Datapacks can add matching recipes. Hafnium reaches higher into the Overworld than Rhodium or Rhenium, so the two-grit Crusher route is a worthwhile trade of 1,200 energy per raw ore when fortune is unavailable. The powered Lattice Laminator also plates 3 forge:ingots/hafnium into a shield in 160 ticks at 24 FE/t; shield recyclers return only one iron ingot, never hafnium.
